caption: The image shows a rectangular stone or stone-like relief drawing in grayscale. At the top, there is an inscription in German letters reading "HIRSTEIN IEGER AUF DER JAGT ALSO." Below the large blank central section, there is a narrow horizontal panel running along the bottom of the relief, containing a sequence of carved figures. In this panel, from left to right, there are two quadruped animals with antlers, resembling deer, each facing right. Between the animals and further to the right is a human figure standing and facing right as well, holding a staff or spear-like object. There are also several circular symbols above or near the animals and the figure, as well as a star-shaped symbol toward the right end of the panel, and another smaller quadruped animal to the far right. The entire relief has a raised edge that frames the composition. The color is monochromatic, appearing as varying shades of gray.
title: Pa. German Stove Plate
